subject: pathology
title: Cholesterol and Pigment Gallstones, Cholecystitis, Porcelain Gallbladder, and Biliary Cancers

steps.tx: Cholesterol gallstones crystallise when bile supersaturates with cholesterol, nucleation accelerates, and gallbladder hypomotility lets crystals grow, classically in multiparous women of Western diets yet increasingly universal. Supersaturation starts the **cholesterol gallstone (cholelithiasis)**. This point is tested repeatedly because it changes everyday bedside decisions.
steps.say: Supersaturated bile, nucleation, and a lazy gallbladder grow cholesterol stones over years.

steps.tx: Pigment stones split black from haemolysis and cirrhosis, hard calcium bilirubinate in gallbladder, and brown from infected ducts, soft bilirubinate with bacteria and parasites behind oriental cholangiohepatitis. Colour separates chemistry: **black versus brown pigment gallstones**. Examiners return to it because it separates careful clinicians from guesswork.
steps.say: Black stones mean haemolysis in the gallbladder; brown stones mean infected bile ducts.

steps.tx: Biliary colic hurts steadily in right upper quadrant or epigastrium for under six hours as stone transiently blocks cystic duct, while persistence beyond six hours with fever and Murphy sign declares cholecystitis. Duration separates them: **biliary colic versus acute cholecystitis**. Bedside recognition of this pattern saves time, blood, and unnecessary investigation.
steps.say: Colic settles within hours; pain beyond six hours with fever and Murphy sign is cholecystitis.

steps.tx: Acute cholecystitis usually obstructs cystic duct with stone, gallbladder distending, inflaming, and risking gangrene, empyema, and perforation, while acalculous disease stalks critically ill patients. Early laparoscopic removal rules: **acute calculous cholecystitis**. Students should anchor this fact before moving to rarer causes and exceptions.
steps.say: Blocked cystic duct plus infection pressure makes acute cholecystitis; early cholecystectomy is its cure.

steps.tx: Chronic cholecystitis scars gallbladder through repeated colic and inflammation, Rokitansky-Aschoff sinuses herniating mucosa through muscular defects into wall, sometimes harbouring bacteria between attacks. Those mucosal outpouchings are **Rokitansky-Aschoff sinuses of chronic cholecystitis**. In practice this distinction decides the next test, treatment, or referral made.
steps.say: Mucosa herniating through wall defects names Rokitansky-Aschoff sinuses in the scarred gallbladder.

vis.caption: Porcelain gallbladder with calcified wall, an extreme of chronic gallbladder disease.

steps.tx: Porcelain gallbladder calcifies its wall into brittle blue brittleness visible on plain imaging, historically linked to carcinoma strongly enough for prophylactic cholecystectomy discussions now individualised by calcification pattern. The calcified end stage is **porcelain gallbladder**. That is why this detail earns its place in every examination and ward round.
steps.say: A calcified gallbladder wall earns surgical discussion; modern imaging refines its cancer risk by pattern.

steps.tx: Gallbladder carcinoma hides inside cholecystectomy specimens or presents late invading liver segments four and five, stones and chronic inflammation its soil, porcelain and polyps its warning lesions. Incidental discovery governs **gallbladder carcinoma presentation patterns**. Remembering it prevents the commonest errors made with this presentation entirely.
steps.say: Most gallbladder cancers are surprises in cholecystectomy specimens or tragedies presenting too late.

steps.tx: Cholangiocarcinoma scars bile ducts at perihilar Klatskin confluence, intrahepatic, or distal sites from PSC, liver flukes, and chronic duct inflammation, painless jaundice its herald. Classification by anatomy is **cholangiocarcinoma, intrahepatic, perihilar, distal**. The clinical payoff comes from applying it early, before complications accumulate further.
steps.say: Painless jaundice with a hilar stricture means Klatskin tumour until brushings and imaging acquit it.
